description.narrative: timbuktoo South Africa is a national contribution to the broader timbuktoo initiative, a pan-African innovation platform designed to nurture and scale youth-led startups across the continent. The project comprises two distinct components: the timbuktoo Creatives Hub, located in Cape Town, and the timbuktoo University Pod (UniPod), based at the University of Johannesburg. Together, these components aim to stimulate youth entrepreneurship, drive inclusive innovation, and strengthen pathways from ideation to investment-readiness within South Africa’s innovation ecosystem.The Creatives Hub will serve as a national and continental focal point for creative entrepreneurs by providing curated programmes, co-creation spaces, and access to markets and strategic partners. The UniPod will function as a physical and institutional platform for capacity-building, prototyping, and innovation-led learning tailored for students and early-stage entrepreneurs. The project is implemented under the coordination of UNDP South Africa in collaboration with national partners and aligns with national development priorities to support youth employment, enterprise development, and inclusive economic growth
